rule: Shapes and flame patterns use the maker's own words. A model gets a shape only where the maker states one: Mendota's shape pages, or another maker's model name, product page or published specs. Nothing is judged from photos. Front or door options (an arched screen front, arched or rectangular doors) are options, not the model's shape.

groups.landscape: Landscape format: Mendota's Landscape shape, Kozy Heat's Bellingham series
groups.linear: A long, linear fire: makers call it Linear, Tall Linear or Widescreen
groups.arch: An arched firebox, door or glass top
groups.rumford: A Rumford-style firebox: shallow, with angled sides and a curved throat

viewing_options.single_sided: viewed from the front (listed only where the maker offers it alongside other options)
viewing_options.corner: viewed from the front and one side
viewing_options.three_sided: viewed from the front and both sides (bay)
